prompt: Create a Python 3.12 library application managing books, members and loans. A member can borrow multiple books, but a book can have at most one active loan. Users must be able to create and close loans and determine which books are currently available.

intentions.text: I can create a loan for a book by a member.
intentions.requires: a book (by ISBN or title), a member (by ID or name)
intentions.observable: Confirmation message indicating the loan has been successfully created and the book is now loaned out.

intentions.text: I can close an existing loan for a book.
intentions.requires: a loan ID or book and member details to identify the loan
intentions.observable: Confirmation message indicating the loan has been successfully closed and the book is now available.

intentions.text: I can check which books are currently available for borrowing.
intentions.observable: A list of books that are not currently loaned out, showing title and ISBN (or other identifying fields).
